programme.title: Sold In 60 Seconds
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. A fierce bidding war ensues over a Mercedes-Benz 250 SL. Sabby rides shotgun in a vintage Harley Davidson's sidecar and we discover an MG roadster with a unique history.

programme.title: IGNITION GT
programme.desc: 'S26/E9'. Zee gets behind the wheel of the eagerly awaited Jetour T1. We bring you highlights from the 2026 VW Indaba in Gqeberha and Ernest gets his first taste of the Tata Harrier.

programme.title: Cape Route Rally
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Our convoy of 8 rigs made our way into the bush as we did a quick warmup lap of Koningskop 4x4 Track. We bounced over to Marcuskraal to take on their track.

programme.title: #CarClipz
programme.desc: 'S3/E10'. On the season finale, we kick it off with 'Not My Day,' take a detour to catch some Transformers, and close out with, 'Impressed or Disappointed' featuring Okay Wasabi & Ziphorah.

programme.title: Auto Mundial
programme.desc: 'S26/E9'. The latest Porsche 911 Turbo marks 50+ years, does it live up to the legacy? We cover 2026 Ram truck updates and how Amazon is reshaping car buying in the deep dive feature.

programme.title: Rev
programme.desc: 'S26/E9'. Trump wields tariffs to protect US autos, blocking Chinese EVs and pushing factories home. But the costs land on American carmakers and buyers.

programme.title: 25th Passion For Speed
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. The annual Passion for Speed Event held at Zwartkops Raceway is South Africa's largest circuit racing event. With legendary cars and drivers, the 25th running was spectacular.

programme.title: Caffeine And Octane
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Ryan Hardwick transitions from Jet Ski to Lamborghini racing with millennial strategies, sharing insights with Drag Racer Rickey Gadson.

programme.title: Red Bull The Ultimate Gusheshe
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. Spinning star Sam Sam takes on a one-month challenge to build his dream gusheshe, and prove that spinning is more than just smoke and chaos.

programme.title: Cape Route Rally
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. The day started at the Lambersbay Dunes. After spending the morning playing the red-ish Kalahari powder sand we made our way to the Boegoeberg 4x4 track.

programme.title: Just To See How Far It Is
programme.desc: 'S2/E1'. Marius Robers travels far and wide discovering new places and sharing the stories of the incredible people he meets along the way!

programme.title: Motorhoming with Merton & Webster
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Their first destination is Minehead where they charter a fishing boat, landing a small haul of fish. Driving through the Cheddar Gorge they visit a motor museum.

programme.title: MythBusters
programme.desc: 'S9/E2 - Titanic Survival'. Fans challenge director James Cameron to explain why characters Rose and Jack didn't share their life raft to survive the Titanic. Plus, what is rocket surfing?

programme.title: Stunt Heroes
programme.desc: 'S1/E1'. The Stunt Heroes have a new car cannon in their equipment arsenal that accelerates a car in one second from zero to 70 km/h. The team tests the cannon after shooting a wild car chase.

programme.title: The Bike Show
programme.desc: 'S26/E10'. We bring you all the latest bikes released to the SA market. There's also news on the latest biking gadgets and features on the massive biking culture in South Africa.

programme.desc: 'S3/E5'. Derek picks up 'emerging' sporting classics, 3 Datsun Zs. A unique lot arrives that run on caterpillar tracks on wheels. Sarah struggles with an old jukebox's instructions.

programme.title: Sold In 60 Seconds

programme.desc: 'S3/E73'. Nalan gets to enjoy her own space for the first time in her life, while Hayri tries to tell her something important.

programme.title: Dokter Ali
programme.desc: 'S2/E71'. Doruk makes an interesting discovery about Vuslat. Demir and Doruk make a bet about a patient. Ferman isn't happy about who's administering the Adil Erinc Fund.

programme.title: Kelders Van Geheime
programme.desc: 'S2/E215'. Veronique is petrified when she realises who the kidnapper is. The Marais's are buckling under the additional pressure op harvest time. Warren is determined to prove that he deserves to be back.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S1/E216'. Yaman starts trying to fix his broken relationship with Seher with small gestures like inviting Firat to breakfast. Seher isn't sure of what's real and what's not.

programme.title: Sout van die Aarde
programme.desc: 'S1/E31'. A singing competition has Keriman and Asuman on their feet. Will they compete? The cousins are busy with their next big moolah project. What do they have in store now?

programme.title: Kelders Van Geheime
programme.desc: 'S2/E216'. As harvest begins at Soebatskloof, past secrets resurface, testing the Marais and Syster families. Their legacy will be shaped not by blood, but by the strength to face hard truths and grow from them.

programme.title: Blink Kant Bo
programme.desc: 'S3/E38'. Ifakat pushes Ferit and Seyran as foreclosure hits, while Kazim is kidnapped for ransom and Betül's secret with Tayfun is exposed.

programme.title: Chrysalis
programme.desc: 'S3/E74'. Billur and Hafize warns Nalan not to trust people so easily. Ismail asks Dondu to dinner. Sedat packs up Nalan' belongings.

programme.title: Die Vertroueling
programme.desc: 'S1/E25'. Sami's men are closing in on Ilhan with murder in their eyes. Will he be able to save himself? Will Marasli and Mahnoor be able to save their relationship?

programme.title: The Other Wife
programme.desc: 'S1/E65'. Sema's dark schemes threaten to tear the family apart. As Karan uncovers more lies, can he hold onto Ceylan, or will the truth break everything they've built?

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S4/E12'. When the Parekh family's attempt to kill Manyata fails miserably, she furiously vows to wreak havoc upon them. Brinda arrives at the temple to rescue the Parekh family, but she turns into a shape shifting serpent.
